title: crocus vernus var. albiflorus
intro: Crocus vernus var. albiflorus, commonly known as White Crocus, is a type of flowering plant in the Iridaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is said to have health benefits such as improving cognitive function, reducing inflammation, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of White Crocus include its potential to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic, although further research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of White Crocus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
